WIP.

I think that Madam M was the best semi-importannt NPC added to the Final Fantasy VII Remake, she adds the esoteric and mystique of remote eastern cultures to the western cybernoir environment of Midgar very well.

I have something for cleary western women roleplaying as classy far-east dames. She is amusing in-game when dropping the act, going back to her crude and rowdy streetwise behavior.

She is clearly a foil to Scarlet, who is an complete upstack blonde bitch, instead of being a whore with a golden heart like Madam M.

A short story about Madam M from Final Fantasy VII - with creative liberties taken, to give more adherence to Madam M to the Avalanche plot from the Midgard section of the game, involving her more directly in the feud against the tyramnical Don Corneo.

Gallery also features post-story bonus artworks depicitng Madam M performing unique types of brothel-like or massage-parlor services to customers, each artwork will be a direct reference to the in-game Materia system, mostly Magic Materia and Enemy SKill Materia.

For the moment, but few of the overall post-story artworks.
